title: Synthetic '⚠ Ruptures (N)' bucket: N count, key-collision, filtering
proof: RUPTURES_BUCKET_KEY='__ruptures__' (line 237). Real bucket keys are item-${id}/cat-${id}/extra-${group_label}/var-${attribute_id} (lines 325/333/345/353/365/373) — none can equal '__ruptures__': no key collision. Live curl GET /api/admin/stock/catalog-overview on :8769 (foodking_dash_e2e, branch_id=1, real 45-item Le Cayenne catalog) → 200 JSON: 45 item rows across 11 categories with 45 UNIQUE ids (ZERO intra-axis duplication), 26 extra rows + 35 var rows with ZERO duplicate composite keys. Union N=1 (one out-of-stock), union-internal :keys had ZERO duplicates → N is not double-counted and no Vue duplicate-:key. Item payload keys = ['id','name','slug','thumb','is_available','reason'] — NO low-stock/threshold field exists in the model, so is_available=false IS the only rupture signal: N counts only true ruptures, not low-stock. activeBucket getter (line 407-408) find(b=>b.key===activeBucketKey); click sets activeBucketKey=bucket.key (template line 76) → selecting the synthetic bucket resolves and renders its items: filtering works. pickDefaultBucketKey (line 457-464) skips the synthetic bucket so landing view never flips with stock; buckets watcher (line 423-428) preserves selection and falls back gracefully when N drops to 0.
reproduction: curl -s -H 'x-api-key:<key>' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' http://127.0.0.1:8769/api/admin/stock/catalog-overview → analyzed: 45 unique item ids, N=1, 0 dup keys. Vitest tests/js/stockRuptureDashboardComponent.spec.js + stockRuptureDashboardMount.spec.js = 9 specs PASS.
remediation: None required. (Robustness backlog only: if items ever become multi-category in a future catalog, dedup the union by .key — not a V1 concern; live data has no dups.)

title: Export error-path: alertService.error(err.response.data.message) on a blob response is undefined
verdict: SUSPECTED (pre-existing codebase norm, not a W4 regression)
proof: xls() catch reads err.response.data.message, but the request is responseType:'blob' → on a server error axios delivers err.response.data as a Blob, so .message is undefined and the alert shows nothing/empty. HOWEVER this is the established codebase pattern: the proven-working reference PosOrderListComponent.vue:404 does alertService.error(err.response.data.message) with the SAME blob problem and LESS guarding (no err.response existence check). W4's xls() is strictly MORE defensive (guards err && err.response && err.response.data && err.response.data.message before alerting). So W4 matches the norm and degrades to a no-op alert (not a crash). Happy path proven 200 XLSX (see WD-05); V1 is single-operator. Low.
reproduction: Compare HistoriqueListComponent.vue:511-515 vs PosOrderListComponent.vue:404 (identical .message-on-blob pattern; W4 is more guarded).
remediation: Backlog (whole-codebase): decode blob error bodies (await err.response.data.text() then JSON.parse) before reading .message. Not W4-specific; defer with the POS export.

title: Export dropdown UI gate (pos-orders) narrower than backend gate (pos-orders|pos)
proof: Export dropdown gated v-if="permissionChecker('pos-orders')" (template line 10). Backend export gate (Adversary F's controller) per commit message = 'can pos-orders|pos'.
